Type: Weapon
Current Holder: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt}
First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.u04lXzbSCHW2OEf7]{Session 3}

Description

A great two-handed sword carried by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt}.
Where gold inlay once decorated the blade, empty channels now glow with a sense of dread — the omen that drove Garland from the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale}.
The enchanted weapon ignores armor and has a forceful knockback quality.

Properties

  • Ignores armor on strikes
  • Forceful knockback on impact
  • The empty gold channels emit a faint dread-glow

History

Originally a legendary blade called Halcyrax, the Gilded Ruin, taken as a spoil of war in a far-off land.
When @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} settled in the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} and started his farm, he beat the legendary weapon into a ploughshare and used it to build his homestead.
During a harsh winter, he melted out its gold inlay to feed the vale.
When he left home again, he reforged the ploughshare back into a sword.
Where the gold once lay, the blade now glows with dread — the omen that compelled Garland to leave his home and set out once more.
